gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and unfussy, its tall midsection giving each curve a wide-open mouth. And Delius Unicase, relaxed and inviting up top, keeps a longer page feeling friendly instead of stiff.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-krub: Relaxed handwriting leads in Delius Unicase, with no swelling in its bowls and a pronounced x-height. Krub follows with pen-lifted curves and a similarly tall build, so the two sit together like neighbors.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-kufam: Delius Unicase writes like a loose, friendly hand, with spacing like rungs on a rope ladder. Its job is warmth and personality; Kufam's is a clean single-width line, open curves, and bodies that dominate while ascenders hardly show.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend: Crossbars as fat as the stems they join give Delius Unicase its handmade, easygoing look up top. Lexend then reads smoothly on, with open curves and generous lowercase.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads clean and approachable, a plain unshaded line with big lowercase and small-looking capitals. But Delius Unicase above it keeps a long stretch of text feeling relaxed, never stiff or cold.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-exa: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase writes like a hand. Lexend Exa does the opposite job, holding a uniform line with wide-open curves and stubby ascenders beside its big x-height.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-giga: Strokes that never taper where they meet or end give Delius Unicase a rope-ladder rhythm and a handwritten ease. Lexend Giga answers with flat linework and generous tracking.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-mega: Inviting from the first letter, Delius Unicase writes with a pronounced x-height and blunt stroke ends. Lexend Mega handles the rest, though if you shrink the heading or enlarge the body, their near-matching heights start to blur.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads professional yet approachable, with wide-mouthed curves and a big x-height. Delius Unicase, relaxed and handwritten above it, keeps a long page feeling warm, never corporate or stiff.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-tera: Relaxed handwriting meets precision here, Delius Unicase against Lexend Tera. One feels like a hand on paper; the other like a plotter pen, its letters spaced as far apart as stepping stones.
